name: Blue Dirt Farm
tagline: Harnessing nature's wisdom and power, restoring diversity, abundance, and natural synergies!
description: Blue Dirt Farm is an on-farm market in 8574 377th Avenue, MN, selling produce straight from the field. Because everything is sold where it is grown, selection follows the local harvest calendar. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
